description: The plot illustrates how the number of shared Top-6 routed experts between two independent samples changes with sample token count across several task types (Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, Math). The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a base-2 logarithmic progression shown as discrete tick labels from \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\) (one tick per power of two). The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples,” appears linear, and spans roughly from 2.0 up to 6.0 with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. Six solid lines (no visible markers) are shown: the Intent line (orange) starts near 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.3 at \(2^{10}\), dips to about 3.9 at \(2^{11}\), then increases to about 5.2 at \(2^{12}\) and stays around 5.5–5.7 through \(2^{17}\), reaching about 6.0 at \(2^{19}\) and remaining about 6.0 at \(2^{20}\); the Summary line (blue) starts near 1.9 at \(2^9\), rises to about 3.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), dips slightly to about 4.5 at \(2^{12}\), then climbs to about 5.4 at \(2^{14}\) and about 5.7–5.8 from \(2^{15}\) to \(2^{17}\), ending near 6.0 at \(2^{20}\); the Law line (gold) begins near 3.6 at \(2^9\), increases to about 4.3 at \(2^{10}\) and about 5.1 at \(2^{11}\), drops to about 4.6 at \(2^{12}\), then rises to about 5.6 at \(2^{13}\) and about 5.8 at \(2^{14}\), fluctuates slightly around 5.6–6.0 through \(2^{20}\) and ends just under 6.0; the Translation line (purple) starts around 5.1 at \(2^9\), increases to about 5.3 at \(2^{10}\), dips to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then rises to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\) and about 5.7 at \(2^{13}\), stays near 5.6–5.9 from \(2^{14}\) through \(2^{20}\), ending around 6.0; the Code line (gray) starts near 1.9 at \(2^9\), stays near 2.0 at \(2^{10}\), rises to about 2.9 at \(2^{11}\) and about 3.1 at \(2^{12}\), reaches about 3.7 at \(2^{13}\), dips to about 3.1 at \(2^{14}\), then increases steadily to about 4.2 at \(2^{15}\), about 4.8 at \(2^{16}\), about 5.3 at \(2^{17}\), about 5.7 at \(2^{19}\), and ends near 5.8 at \(2^{20}\); and the Math line (green) begins near 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), increases to about 5.0 at \(2^{12}\) and about 5.3 at \(2^{13}\), stays around 5.3–5.5 through \(2^{15}\), then rises to about 5.7 at \(2^{16}\) and about 5.9 at \(2^{18}\), dips slightly near 5.8 at \(2^{19}\), and ends just under 6.0 at \(2^{20}\).
